result.title: Test-Time Adaptation of Quantized ViTs via Single-Pass Quantizer-Aligned Recalibration
result.summary: Post-training quantization is a standard route to fitting vision transformers (ViTs) into edge compute and memory budgets, yet quantized models become especially brittle under distribution shift. Test-time adaptation (TTA) addresses such shifts without labels, but most existing approaches are poorly aligned with the constraints of quantized inference. Prevailing TTA methods recover accuracy through backpropagation, while backprop-free methods often still incur overhead from extra forward passes or parameter updates, and lightweight feature- or logit-level methods recover only part of the loss. Across these approaches, a quantization-specific failure mode that amplifies the drop is not directly targeted: under shift, activations occupy frozen quantizers' calibrated ranges differently, distorting their code distribution. We propose Quantizer-Aligned Recalibration (QuAR), a single-pass TTA method tailored to quantized ViTs that neither backpropagates nor updates any model parameters. QuAR recalibrates activations at the input to a frozen quantizer, mapping the test stream's running per-channel statistics back toward the source calibration. On ImageNet-C with ViT-B, QuAR achieves the highest mean accuracy among state-of-the-art backprop-free TTA methods at 3-, 4-, 6- and 8-bit weight/activation precision, outperforming the strongest baseline by 2.28 points at 8 bits and 4.00 at 3 bits, with 46% lower latency and a memory overhead of only 0.17 MB (0.01% of peak inference memory). Analysis and diagnostics trace the gain to a reduced per-channel mismatch at these quantizers, which restores the code distribution the baselines leave unchanged or distort further. A single fixed configuration remains ahead across continual streams, non-i.i.d. label shift, seven out-of-distribution suites, and three other backbones.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 QuAR，一种针对量化 ViT 的单次前向测试时自适应方法：不反向传播、不更新任何模型参数，仅在冻结量化器输入前利用测试流的逐通道运行时统计量对激活做重校准，使其回到源校准范围。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 主线无直接关联，但其「冻结量化器+用运行时统计校准内部表示」的思路可能可供核查：内部状态分布漂移是否影响 latent 推理状态的可用性，以及单次前向、无参数更新的轻量适配是否类比推理期的表示筛选与缓存复用。
